ordinary.scope: One run-level median; timesteps share run conditions and are not independent repetitions.

transform.scope: Three provisional transitions per step. Fixed kernel records are work descriptors, not FLOPs or time weights. Production bypasses the old complete WT path; oracle runs compare old outputs and restore candidate SOL for real consumers. Traffic excludes metadata and epoch headers; route invocations are not global synchronization rounds. Memory is named numerical/route payload, excludes kernel/geometry metadata, descriptors, compilation peak, retained final-transform workspace and MPI. Rank RSS and whole-step time remain separate gates; final lifecycle and granularity are unchanged.
